ValidationRule.description: Checks whether Location value is blank or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )),OR( ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Incorrect Label'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Invoice Adjustments'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'Incorrect Product'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Product Concern'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Weight Discrepancy'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Delivery Delay'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Demurrage'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Diversion'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Driver Verification/Change'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Equipment Failure'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Incorrect Destination'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Incorrect UOM'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Missing Cargo'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Mode of Transportation'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Route / Directions'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Ship Date / Scheduling'), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Warehouse')), AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), ISBLANK( PMC_SS_Location__c )))
